facts.fact: L'Economiste Maghrébin reports that Tunisia presented the outlines (grandes lignes) of its national AI strategy for 2026-2030 at a ministerial council, carried by ICT Minister Sofiane Hemissi; the article is dated 2026-08-17 and gives no adoption or launch decision.
The article says no precise budget, detailed timetable or result indicators for the strategy had been made public, and names no body charged with carrying it out (article dated 2026-08-17).
